messages:
zoe: Alert - mutual TLS failures from apac-ingest to eu-ingest since 09:12 UTC. App logs show client cert not presented during handshake.
marc: I'm seeing cert provisioning errors: cert-rotator failed to decrypt private key in ap-southeast-1 at 09:11 with AccessDenied. Could be related to the RBAC tighten we merged yesterday.
sre-oncall: Any KMS denies? cloudtrail shows KMS:Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/cert-rotator-role at 09:11:02Z. Link: https://logs.redwood/cloudtrail/1799991111?filter=DecryptDenied
kms-bot: Policy-change note: Automated policy hardener removed wildcard grants from role cert-rotator-role at 2026-04-02T08:55Z. Delta: removed kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111111:key/klmn.
zoe: That key is used for encrypting private material for apac certs. We lost ability to re-issue short-lived certs. Short mitigation?
marc: Quick fix: re-add a scoped grant for cert-rotator-role limited to Decrypt + DescribeKey on the two regional keys, restart rotator, and run a smoke canary. Proposed policy fragment pasted in ticket.
auditor-bot: Reminder - any re-grant must be logged with justification; create PR and link to audit ticket SEC-2026-061 before policy apply.
sre-oncall: I can attach ephemeral grant now and restart pods; will create a post-hoc PR. Steps I will run: `aws kms create-grant --key-id klmn --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111:role/cert-rotator-role --operations Decrypt,DescribeKey --name cert-rotator-temp` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/cert-rotator -n certs` and run TLS canary.
km s-bot: Grant created grantId=g-zzz at 09:18:04Z. cert-rotator logs show Decrypt OK at 09:18:30Z and cert issuance at 09:18:45Z. mTLS sessions restored by 09:19.
zoe: Post-incident follow-ups: 1) Reconcile automated hardener rules vs service key grants (avoid wholesale removal). 2) Add a CI gate that simulates KMS grant removal for critical principals. 3) Enhance probe coverage for mTLS handshake failures by region. 4) Increase audit retention for KMS policy changes to 90d.
marc: I'll open SEC-2026-061, assign to @zoe @marc @sre-oncall and attach logs/commands. Quick evidence commands: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateGrant` and `kubectl logs -n certs deploy/cert-rotator --since=30m | grep Decrypt`.
sre-oncall: Treating as near-miss. We'll schedule a postmortem and add the guardrails. :thumbsup:
